retrievalProfile.description: A collage of overlapping mid-century modern neon signs featuring geometric shapes like stars, circles, and trapezoids against a vibrant yellow gradient.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, layered composition of stylized commercial signs in various geometric housings, supported by thin metal poles, set against a warm yellow-to-white gradient background.
coreVisualRelationships: Overlapping geometric sign housings creating depth
Thin vertical and angled poles anchoring floating elements
High contrast between black/white signage and yellow background
Mix of script and block typography within distinct containers

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Multiple signs of varying sizes fill the frame, with the largest elements in the upper and middle sections.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central black circular sign and the large trapezoidal sign to its right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves in a zig-zag pattern from the top-left sign, down to the central circle, across to the right trapezoid, and finally to the bottom starburst.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily concentrated in the upper corners and between the support poles.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with high-value white and low-value black for maximum legibility.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of high-contrast serif, bold sans-serif, and stylized script.
letterConstructionRules: Heavy strokes with sharp, exaggerated serifs for display text
Angled, italicized block letters for secondary signage
Uniform stroke weight for sans-serif sub-text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Exaggerated descenders and swashes on script elements
Inward-leaning characters to match trapezoidal housing
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrasting a formal decorative serif with a rugged, hand-drawn script and a clean geometric sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the bold, retro commercial feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage of 1950s Googie-style sign housings (circles, stars, trapezoids) on thin metal poles against a yellow gradient background. Leave the sign faces blank.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom-lettered retro typography into the blank sign faces, using high-contrast black and white with sharp serifs and stylized scripts.

verificationChecks: Are the sign housings geometric and dimensional?
Is the background a vibrant yellow gradient?
Is the typography high-contrast and retro-styled?
Are the support poles thin and structural?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure sharp edges on all signage
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [geometric sign housings] + [thin metal poles] + [high-contrast retro typography] + [yellow gradient background] to create a [Googie-style collage].
